atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to insert Tailwind's base, components, and utilities styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the @layer directive to tell Tailwind which bucket a set of custom styles belong to.

properties.name: overflow-scrolling
properties.description: Specifies whether to use native-style scrolling in an overflow container.

properties.name: -webkit-overflow-scrolling
properties.description: Specifies whether to use native-style scrolling in an overflow container on WebKit browsers.

properties.name: -webkit-tap-highlight-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the highlight that appears over a link while it's being tapped.

properties.name: overscroll-behavior
properties.description: Sets what a browser does when reaching the boundary of a scrolling area.
